subject.title: feat(mattermost): auto-engage on replies to the bot's own thread

question: Should Mattermost ship default-on reply-to-bot auto-engagement for bot-authored thread roots, and is current CI/unit proof enough without a live Mattermost roundtrip?
rationale: The patch appears mechanically sound, but it intentionally widens when Mattermost sends agent replies under existing mention/onchar gating, which is a maintainer policy and proof decision.

options.title: Request Live Roundtrip First
options.body: Ask for a redacted real Mattermost run showing a user reply without @mention in a bot-authored thread and the bot answering before merge.

options.title: Accept CI-Only Proof
options.body: Merge if maintainers accept default-on parity and consider the focused unit tests plus green CI sufficient for this member-authored PR.

options.title: Pause For Stricter Policy
options.body: Pause the PR if bot-root auto-engagement should be opt-in or narrower than Slack/Telegram-style parity.

recommendation.title: Request Live Roundtrip First
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted real Mattermost run showing a user reply without @mention in a bot-authored thread and the bot answering before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current PR and the merged participated-thread work it composes with, so they are the best routing candidate for the Mattermost policy/proof follow-up.
